title: Anim8gen Animation Brief
description: Structured brief produced by Codex from a natural-language request before initializing an Anim8gen package.

id.description: Lowercase package id used for config, asset, preview, and report paths.

subject.description: Main character or object that should appear in every accepted frame.

style.description: Visual style, usually concise enough to fit directly into frame prompts.

view.description: Camera/view direction to preserve across frames.

canvas.description: Final aligned sprite canvas size in pixels.

workingSize.description: Raw generation size expected from the image generator.

maxFrameCount.description: Initial bounded scope for one request. Codex should ask to split broader actions.

runtimeEffects.description: Preview-only overlays or effects that must not be baked into source sprite pixels unless explicitly requested.

clarificationPolicy.description: When to ask the user instead of guessing.
clarificationPolicy.default: Ask for clarification when subject, view, frame count, or core action is ambiguous; otherwise choose conservative defaults and document them.

unsupportedHandling.description: How to handle requests outside the first Anim8gen scope.
unsupportedHandling.default: Decline or narrow requests for long cinematic animation, multi-character scenes, four-direction packs, complex physics, or production-grade motion.

frames.description: Ordered pose plan. Indexes must be contiguous from 0 and labels become file-name slugs.
